_doc: Written pitches inside an instrument's range (lo..ext) that have no fingering entry. A 'kind' entry covers every instrument of that kind at that written MIDI pitch; an 'inst' entry covers one instrument. checked = sources looked at (with what each prints, where they disagree). system 'german' = recorder note where the German system has no sourced fingering although the baroque table has one; entries without system concern the baroque/default tables. Keep in sync with docs/fingering-gaps.md.

gaps.note: B♭6 (altissimo): no soprano fingering printed by both sources
B6 (altissimo): no tenor fingering printed by both sources
B6 (altissimo): no baritone fingering printed by both sources

German G♯ (index 8): charts print three fingerings. T 12–|45–– (WFG, Bolton, Blockis general chart); T 12–|45 + half 6 (Yamaha German chart; Bolton and Blockis as alternative); T 12–|456– (Dolmetsch German chart, Aulos via Blockis). The makers of German-system recorders all cover hole 6 at least half.
checked: Philippe Bolton German fingering chart (T 12–|45––; alternative half 6)
Blockis German fingering chart (T 12–|45––; alternative half 6)
Aulos German chart as transcribed by Blockis (T 12–|456–)
Tomplay recorder chart (German only as PDF, not read)
